research_question: How did North Atlantic sea surface temperature and benthic isotopes evolve between 812 and 530 ka during the mid-Pleistocene transition?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are investigating changes in North Atlantic circulation during the mid-Pleistocene transition (MIS20-MIS14). Alongside our own new foraminifer data from the Iberian margin we need previously published reference datasets: benthic oxygen isotopes at Site U1385, and sea surface temperatures at DSDP Site 607. Please search PANGAEA to find the exact dataset identifiers for those two reference records.

phase_2.user_prompt: I have the PANGAEA dataset DOIs for the required reference data: 10.1594/PANGAEA.701229 (Site 607) and 10.1594/PANGAEA.872082 (Site U1385). Please download the tabular datasets for both so that we can begin temporally aligning the sea surface temperature and benthic isotope series for the 812-530 ka interval.
